_comment: Webpack modules in the admin bundles whose CJK string literals are NOT display text. translate.mjs leaves them byte-for-byte alone and guard.mjs permits them. Matching is by file + module id so control characters and regex metacharacters never have to be quoted as values.

modules.why: regjsparser: fragments used to compose fuzzy URL/email matcher regexes (e.g. `(^|(?![.:/\-_@])(?:[$+<=>^`|｜]|`). The fullwidth vertical bar is a regex delimiter, never rendered.
Core-js: the ECMAScript whitespace / line-terminator character list used by String.prototype.trim polyfills. Contains U+3000 IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE as a code point in a lookup table.
he: HTML entity name table. Its CJK entries are Unicode range identifiers inside one large JSON.parse() blob, not UI text.
zrender: text-measurement probe. Measures the rendered width of a CJK glyph against an ASCII glyph to derive a font metric; the character is an input to measurement and is never displayed.
zrender: second copy of the same CJK glyph-width measurement probe.
regjsparser: second bundled copy of the fuzzy URL/email matcher regex source fragments.

notes.moment: The moment zh-cn locale (vendors.async.js module XDpg) IS translated rather than allowlisted: umi.js calls moment.locale("zh-cn"), so its month, weekday, relative-time and calendar strings are what the dashboard actually renders. Its regex members (meridiemParse, dayOfMonthOrdinalParse) are regex literals, which the tokenizer never matches, so they are structurally protected from rewrite.
notes.echarts: The ECharts locale in vendors.async.js (module 71kh, 92 strings) is also translated: an English locale is bundled in the same chunk but nothing calls registerLocale, so the Chinese one is the default and the only one charts currently draw from.
